question: Sine bars are used when a high degree of accuracy less than _________ is needed for measuring angles.
solution:
The correct answer is __1 minute**(1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sine bars__ are precision tools used for measuring angles.
 
• Sine bars are utilized for angles requiring accuracy less than 1 minute.
 
• They work based on the principle of trigonometry.
 
• Typically used in conjunction with gauge blocks to achieve the desired angle.
 
• Common applications include inspection and calibration in engineering.
 
• They are available in various sizes and materials to suit specific needs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Angle Measurement Tools:**
 
 
• Protractors are basic tools for measuring angles.
 
• Clinometers are advanced tools for measuring slopes and angles.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Sine Bars:**
 
 
• Used in machine shops for setting up workpieces.
 
• Applicable in tool and die making for precise measurements.
 
 
 
• **Limitations of Sine Bars:**
 
 
• Accuracy depends on the precision of gauge blocks.
 
• Not suitable for measuring angles greater than 45 degrees.
